scientific_boundary: Artificial connectome-inspired model; not biological evidence about real fly memory, behavior, or consciousness.

hypotheses.H1: With informative context cues, the contextual dual-trace agent stores opposite policies and retrieves the policy matching the cue.
hypotheses.H2: Retrieval advantage and switch performance fall as cue reliability approaches chance.
hypotheses.H3: Removing context or shuffling cues removes the retrieval advantage; removing the slow trace weakens retention and reacquisition savings.

definitions.storage: positive banana-minus-cucumber contrast for context X and negative contrast for context Y after reversal
definitions.retrieval: frozen-policy accuracy under correct versus counterfactual wrong cue
definitions.switch_cost: overall alternating-block accuracy minus accuracy on the first three trials after each switch
definitions.reacquisition_savings: initial acquisition trials-to-criterion minus context-X reacquisition trials-to-criterion
